## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The matters-and-meanings glossary (*shìyì* 事義) volume of [通理](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E7%90%86) Tōnglǐ's four-text *Fǎhuá jīng zhǐzhǎng shū* commentarial complex (see [KR6d0095](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0095)). Provides the topical-encyclopedic apparatus accompanying the *Zhǐzhǎng shū* main commentary ([KR6d0097](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0097)).

**Abstract**

The *Shìyì* completes the four-text *Zhǐzhǎng shū* complex by providing the topical-encyclopedic glossary of names, terms, and concepts referenced in the main commentary. Together, the four-text complex ([KR6d0095](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0095) *kēwén* / [KR6d0096](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0096) *xuánshì* / [KR6d0097](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0097) *Zhǐzhǎng shū* / [KR6d0098](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0098) *Shìyì*) provides the most fully-apparatus-equipped mid-Qīng Lotus Sūtra commentarial production, complete with sectional analysis, introductory exposition, main commentary, and topical glossary.

The dating is bracketed with the rest of the four-text complex within Tōnglǐ's mature productive period c. 1750–1782.
